newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 2.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones fell 101.10 points to 6,448.27. PLDT's ADR fell 25 cents to $51.
* On Friday, the peso weakened to 26.299 to a U.S. dollar from 26.284.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,170.56, up 5.04.
* The Philippine interbank call loan average rate was down at 11.15625 pct from 10.625 pct.
* Year-on-year inflation in the Philippines is seen rising to 4.9 percent in December from 4.5 percent in November, according to a Reuters poll of five analysts.
* Philippine Journal says port operator International Container Terminal Services Inc is in on the lookout for ports in the country needing expansion and modernisation for possible investments.
* Philippine Daily Inquirer says First Philippine Holdings Corp plans to expand its investment portfolio to include an additional 500-megawatt natural gas-fired power plant in northern Philippines.

* Manila Times says RFM Properties and Holdings Inc, a subsidiary of food and beverage conglomerate RFM Corp has formed a joint venture firm to convert a 133-hectare property into an industrial estate.
* BusinessWorld says Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co officials will go on a roadshow by the end of Janaury to raise $300 million for the company's X-7 expansion programme.
